name: Electrical Charge already ticks, gates on movement, hits 20 stacks and its Charged Conduit exempts Static spend (#1007)
contract: #1007: 704149 'Electrical Charge' (Attributes 448 PASSIVE|DO_NOT_DISPLAY|DO_NOT_LOG, self-applying on learn) has EffectApplyAuraName[0]=23 PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectAmplitude[0]=1000 ms, EffectTriggerSpell[0]=800299; the binding script aura_ascension_electrical_charge (src/server/coa/AscensionStormbringerTalents.cpp:135-169, registered by spell_script_names in data/sql/updates/pending_db_world/rev_1789379311228000700.sql:17-21) ticks that trigger once per second while the owner is not moving and Charged Conduit (803790) is not up, i.e. 'standing still grants Electrical Charge every second'. 800299 has StackAmount=20 (SpellDuration 18 = 20000 ms) and EffectApplyAuraName[0]=216 HASTE_SPELLS with BasePoints 0 + DieSides 1, giving CalcValue=1 (1% haste per stack), matching the tooltip's 'increasing your haste by 1%'; once GetStackAmount() reaches StackAmount(20) the script casts 803790 ('upon reaching 20 stacks'). 803790 (SpellDuration 1 = 10000 ms, 'for 10 sec') has its EFFECT_2 REMOVE_AURA(800299) zeroed at load by stormbringer_resource_contracts (AscensionStormbringerTalents.cpp:103-104) and instead removes 800299 in aura_ascension_charged_conduit::OnRemove (:171-185) when the conduit itself expires ('after which the charges are depleted'). While 803790 is up, Static (803102) spend from the module's tabled ResourceCostRules is skipped for CLASS_STORMBRINGER (AscensionCompat.cpp:2390-2393, mirrored for native stack-effect spenders in src/server/game/Spells/SpellEffects.cpp:345-348), matching 'your spells dont deplete Static'. Call Lightning 500040 is one such tabled rule: {16, 500040, 500040, 803102, 50, ResourceConsumption::Fixed} (AscensionCustomResourceData.h:526) and is not itself a class-16 Static generator (absent from the ResourceGainRules ranges at :140-160/:197-214), so it isolates the spend exemption cleanly. No code change exists for this issue; this is a regression scenario proving the mechanic already works end to end.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Learn Electrical Charge (self-applying passive)
No Electrical Charge stacks yet, before the first 1000 ms tick
Stand still (movement flag off)
Let the periodic trigger tick a few times at 1000 ms amplitude
BASELINE: standing still grants Electrical Charge stacks (one per 1000 ms tick, lower bound only)
Start moving
The fixture is moving
While moving, no further ticks should land
DISCRIMINATING: Electrical Charge does not grow while moving (isMoving() gate)
Stand still again
Enter combat so Static (803102) cannot decay for the rest of the scenario (DecayStatic returns early while IsInCombat())
Learn Call Lightning, a tabled Static spender not itself a class-16 Static generator
Charged Conduit is not up yet (still below 20 stacks)
Fixture Static at the display maximum
Cast Call Lightning without Charged Conduit up
BASELINE: Call Lightning's tabled Fixed cost of 50 Static applies normally
Let the GCD from Call Lightning clear
Push Electrical Charge to the 19/20 threshold
Let one more 1000 ms tick land, taking the stack to 20 and casting Charged Conduit
Electrical Charge reaches its DBC StackAmount of 20
Charged Conduit is applied at the 20-stack threshold
Re-fixture Static at the display maximum for the exemption test
Cast the same Call Lightning while Charged Conduit is up
DISCRIMINATING: with Charged Conduit up, Static is not spent (spend loop breaks before ModifyAuraStacks)

Start moving so the still-running 1000 ms passive (Charged Conduit's 10000 ms duration is an exact multiple of it) cannot regenerate a stack on the same tick Charged Conduit expires, isolating depletion from the already-proven movement gate
Let Charged Conduit's 10000 ms duration expire
Charged Conduit has expired
DEPLETION: Electrical Charge's 20 stacks are removed when Charged Conduit expires ('after which the charges are depleted')
